programs.title: Secrets in the Ice
programs.desc: Mysterious industrial waste and abandoned homes in an uninhabited part of Greenland; strange ditches and mounds deep within the Arctic Circle; a huge pyramid on the Kazakh steppe; a ball of golden fur in Yukon's gold fields.

programs.title: Fishing for History
programs.desc: Dateline 1903, 4:10am. One of the largest and deadliest rock slides in Canadian history nearly buried the mining town including its local bank. In the years after, a legend of 500,000 lost banknotes floated around.

programs.title: How I Got Here
programs.sub_title: Ghana: That Name That You Live
programs.desc: Doris takes her daughter, Shetin, to Ghana to learn the truth behind her royal bloodline.

programs.title: The Animal Within
programs.desc: Learn whether the animal kingdom hold the key to immortality; when humans are injured, we have the benefit of medicine and surgery; these skills pale in comparison to nature's super healers.

programs.title: Quest for the Lost Vikings
programs.desc: The search for the lost Viking continues, with the team venturing further into Minnesota lore as residents offer up theories of what happened to the lost Viking. The team is led to multiple sites where remnants of the lost Viking voyage may reside.

programs.title: To Kill a Dictator
programs.desc: Under Saddam Hussein's rule, fearsome purges, mass genocides, political executions, and invasions of neighboring powers become the norm; early murderous tendencies set the stage for years of ruthless resolve.

programs.title: Into the Universe: Mysteries of the Cosmos
programs.desc: Billions of years ago, the first sign of life emerged on Earth; how exactly did this miraculous event unfold? As we probe the past, astronomers turn their telescopes to exoplanets to uncover vital clues about our own origins on planet Earth.

programs.title: Mysteries of the Ancient Dead
programs.desc: At the sacrificial altar El Castillo, where thousands met their death, researchers find new evidence that could shed light on the Maya; a sacred well at Chichen Itza where thousands were deposited and ceramic pieces at Khonkho Wankane mortuary.

programs.title: Ghosts Off Grid
programs.desc: A visit to a late 1700s mansion now bed and breakfast in New Orleans' Garden District gets off to a surprising start when an event from above startles the investigators.

programs.title: Cursed Histories

programs.desc: A gruesome story penned on a centuries-old scroll makes its way across Europe; a stone-age mummy emerges from the icy alps; an ancient city in Afghanistan is reduced to rubble.

programs.title: Ancient Bodies: Secrets Revealed
programs.desc: An archeologist makes the 22,000-foot journey to the peak of an Argentinian mountain near an active volcano and discovers the remains of children perfectly preserved as though they are asleep.

programs.title: Phantom Signals
